discrepancy_explanation: Phase 10.2 and Phase 10.3 evaluated identical baseline models instantiated with fc_units=128 (106,244 parameters), yielding identical OOF Macro-F1 of 83.78% and accuracy of 86.26%. The prompt reference to Phase 10.3 having '86.26%' was an accidental citation of OOF accuracy rather than Macro-F1. In Phase 10.4, the baseline was explicitly instantiated with fc_units=64 (73,156 parameters) per prompt instruction, resulting in an expected slight decrease in Fold 1 capacity (val Macro-F1 90.57% vs 94.09%), yielding pooled OOF Macro-F1 of 81.09% and accuracy of 84.69%.
